Just like the mod of a subverse can create sticky posts, the OP of a post should have the option of creating a sticky comment. It would save having to drill through pages of comments to find the OP's original comment (if it contained extra info).

For instance, I post a link to a subverse, then I make a comment afterward explaining about the link (possibly for clarification). I could make that comment sticky so it's always visible at the top of the comments, instead of users having to search for that comment. The option to make a comment sticky should only be at the root level, and never on a reply (I could see where having it for ALL comments would be a nightmare).
[Feature Request] The OP of a post should be able to create sticky comments
Example... this comment could be made sticky by me - since I'm OP, and this is a root-level comment.
...this however, should NOT have the option to make sticky - because it's NOT at the root-level.

Just because this comment is by the OP doesn’t make it the “best” or “most relevant” comment. I think comments should remain sorted by score.

If what you are posting requires explanation beyond the title, make a self-post instead.

In a situation where more explanation is needed. Have you ever seen those "[Details Inside]" posts? In order to find the details, you have to drill through hundreds of comments. It's more convenient to have the OP be able to make that comment sticky. As a caveat, voting should be disabled on sticky comments.

Have you ever seen those "[Details Inside]" posts?

Yes. Like I said, make a self-post instead.

It was a problem on Reddit because users wanted link karma and self-posts provided no karma at all. Here both links and self-posts give the same type of score (SCP), and SCP is meaningless, so write the details in the self-post and be done with it. The OP shouldn’t be able to occupy the top comment automatically; regardless of voting, the first comment has a lot of influence on the discussion that follows. Often the top comment is not the OP’s for good reason — someone else makes a more detailed or relevant comment, or debunks some untruths in the OP’s comment, and it rises to the top by voting.
